description: AdjustmentService called with its required injected session, prior quantity 7 and delta -10, rejects with a validation error naming field 'delta' (message 'quantity would go below zero') and the repository write (quantity update and audit insert) is patched and asserted never called

On the paired branch a direct POST /api/adjustments with delta -10 on a per-run-unique (sku, location) at quantity 7 returns 422 naming field 'delta' and the stock_records quantity read back is still 7
On the paired branch the rejected delta -10 POST writes no stock_adjustments row for the test's own (sku, location) (row-count delta 0)

AdjustmentService called with its required injected session and a set-to-value quantity of -2 rejects with a validation error naming field 'quantity' and the repository write is patched and asserted never called

On the paired branch a direct POST /api/adjustments with quantity -2 on a per-run-unique (sku, location) at quantity 7 returns 422 naming field 'quantity' and the stock_records quantity read back is still 7
On the paired branch the rejected quantity -2 POST writes no stock_adjustments row for the test's own (sku, location) (row-count delta 0)
On the paired branch POST /api/adjustments with delta -7 on a per-run-unique (sku, location) at quantity 7 returns 201 and the stock_records quantity read back is 0
On the paired branch the accepted delta -7 POST writes exactly one stock_adjustments row for the test's own (sku, location) with prior_quantity 7 and new_quantity 0
